en.summary: Fixes StoreController handling of BERT or iGELU configuration commands so the command is actually consumed instead of stalling, and reads the QC parameter from the correct command word.
why_it_counts: The commit title explicitly identifies a stall in StoreController.
The patch changes StoreController command-ready logic in DUT control hardware, not tests or software.
The same commit also corrects BERT QC field decoding in GemminiISA and StoreController, showing the configuration path itself was wrong.
disqualifiers: The commit bundles a ready-handshake fix with a related configuration-field decode fix.
evidence: Before the fix, the DoConfigBert branch updated igelu_qb and igelu_qc but never asserted cmd.ready; the patch adds cmd.ready := true.B there.
GemminiISA removes qc from ConfigBertRs1 and adds qc to ConfigBertRs2, and StoreController switches config_igelu_qc from config_bert_rs1.qc to config_bert_rs2.qc.
The patch adds an assert comparing BERT and mvout cmd_type decoding, reinforcing that this is controller command-format logic.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Configuration commands that only update accelerator state still need to participate in the controller handshake that consumes commands from the front end. If a controller recognizes a special config opcode but never acknowledges it, the command stream can wedge permanently on that entry. A related class of bug is decoding one of the configuration parameters from the wrong operand word, so even a consumed command programs incorrect constants.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: config-command acceptance and parameter decode in a store or output controller
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A configuration-only command reaches the controller while it is waiting for work and the command does not allocate DMA activity or other side effects that would consume it automatically.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Keep the config command path active but do not assert the command-consumed handshake, and optionally source one coefficient from the wrong command operand.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop ready on a config-only branch and misdecode a parameter field
portability_notes: This maps to any accelerator controller that accepts config opcodes through the same queue as data-movement commands.
The highest-value portable mutation is the missing ready or dequeue acknowledgement because it reliably recreates the stall.
Misdecoding one configuration coefficient is a secondary but related mutation if the target DUT exposes multiword config commands.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the controller branch that handles a config opcode without launching a DMA request or other automatic dequeue side effect.
Remove the handshake assignment that marks the command as accepted or ready on that branch.
If the design uses multiword configuration commands, additionally bind one parameter to the wrong word or field while keeping opcode detection unchanged.
Leave normal store or data-movement command handling untouched so the stall is isolated to the config path.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: StoreController DoConfigBert path and CONFIG_BERT field layout
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds cmd.ready on the DoConfigBert branch and moves the QC field definition and decode from rs1 to rs2 for CONFIG_BERT commands.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Remove cmd.ready := true.B from the DoConfigBert branch and, if reproducing the full original bug, decode config_igelu_qc from the old rs1 field layout instead of rs2.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: A BERT or iGELU configuration command can stall the StoreController indefinitely, and if the optional decode mutation is also reintroduced, the programmed QC coefficient is wrong even when the command is consumed.
evidence_for_injection: The stall fix is a single added cmd.ready assertion in the config-only controller branch.
The same commit changes the CONFIG_BERT bitfield layout, showing that the config path had both handshake and parameter-source issues.
The controller sets DoConfigBert separately from DoStore, so the missing ready was sufficient to wedge that path.
notes: For a minimal portable injection, dropping the ready handshake is enough.
The parameter-decode mutation is secondary and should only be added if the target DUT has a similarly split config encoding.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 StoreController 对 BERT/iGELU 配置命令的处理：命令会被真正消费而不再卡死，同时 QC 参数也会从正确的命令字中解析。
why_it_counts: 提交标题明确指出 StoreController 中存在 stall。
补丁修改的是 DUT 控制硬件中的 StoreController command-ready 逻辑，而不是测试或软件。
同一提交还修正了 GemminiISA 与 StoreController 中的 BERT QC 字段解析，说明配置路径本身也存在错误。
disqualifiers: 该提交把 ready 握手修复与相关的配置字段解析修复打包在一起。
evidence: 修复前，DoConfigBert 分支虽然会更新 igelu_qb 和 igelu_qc，但从未拉高 cmd.ready；补丁在该分支中新增了 cmd.ready := true.B。
GemminiISA 把 qc 从 ConfigBertRs1 移除并加入 ConfigBertRs2，而 StoreController 也把 config_igelu_qc 从 config_bert_rs1.qc 改成了 config_bert_rs2.qc。
补丁新增了对 BERT 与 mvout cmd_type 解析一致性的 assert，说明这里确实是控制器命令格式相关逻辑。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 即便某条配置命令只更新加速器内部状态，它也必须参与控制器对前端命令的消费握手。如果控制器能识别该特殊配置 opcode，却从不确认已接收该命令，整个命令流就可能永久卡在这一项上。与之相关的另一类错误，是从错误的操作数字中解析配置参数，导致即使命令被消费，写入的常量仍然是错的。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: store/output controller 中的配置命令接收与参数解析
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一条纯配置命令到达控制器，而此时控制器正等待新工作；该命令本身又不会自动分配 DMA 或其他会隐式消费它的副作用。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 保留配置命令分支，但不再拉高“命令已被接收”的握手；如有需要，再把某个系数改从错误的命令字中解析。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 在纯配置分支上删除 ready，并错误解析一个参数字段
portability_notes: 适用于任何把配置 opcode 与数据搬运命令放在同一命令队列中的加速器控制器。
最有价值、也最可移植的变异是漏掉 ready/dequeue 确认，因为它能稳定重现 stall。
如果目标 DUT 也有多字配置命令，再附加“从错误字段取参数”的变异会更接近原始提交。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到处理“配置 opcode 且不会发起 DMA 请求”的控制器分支。
删除该分支上表示命令已被接受或 ready 的握手赋值。
如果设计使用多字配置命令，可额外把某个参数绑定到错误的字或错误字段，同时保持 opcode 判定不变。
不要修改正常的 store 或数据搬运命令处理，使 stall 被隔离在配置路径上。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: StoreController 的 DoConfigBert 路径以及 CONFIG_BERT 字段布局
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在 DoConfigBert 分支上新增了 cmd.ready，并把 CONFIG_BERT 的 QC 字段定义与解析从 rs1 移到了 rs2。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 删除 DoConfigBert 分支中的 cmd.ready := true.B；如果要完整复现原始问题，再把 config_igelu_qc 改回从旧的 rs1 字段布局中解析。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: BERT/iGELU 配置命令可能让 StoreController 长期卡死；若同时恢复参数解析错误，即使命令被消费，写入的 QC 系数也会错误。
evidence_for_injection: stall 修复本质上只是在纯配置控制分支上新增了一条 cmd.ready。
同一提交还修改了 CONFIG_BERT 的位域布局，说明配置路径同时存在握手与参数来源问题。
controller 将 DoConfigBert 与 DoStore 分开处理，因此仅仅漏掉 ready 就足以让这一路径挂死。
notes: 若只追求最小可移植注入，删除 ready 握手已经足够。
参数解析错误是次要变异，只有当目标 DUT 也存在类似多字配置编码时才建议一并加入。
